theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible theme with the absolute-trend gate confirming participation, is the current leader, and carries a mean-revert hurst tag without a crowding flag. The one-narrative structure plus eligibility is the only leg worth leaning on, but gate_helps=false on this market means the trend signal has not shown drawdown-control value here, so the lean is a fragile persistence call rather than an edge claim.
evidence: hurst_tag=mean-revert (implies pullback risk rather than runaway trend)
theses.dissent: The mean-revert hurst tag plus gate_helps=false on China A-shares history means Coal's 'trend' may already be mid-reversal, and the eligible flag has no validated forward edge on this market.
